title: Kissed Gooey German Apple Tart
description: A roasted, gooey, date-night German dish featuring vanilla bean paste, en-croute, and dairy-free-friendly ingredients, perfect for a romantic evening.

ingredients.name: Apples
ingredients.notes: Granny Smith or other tart variety

instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the flour, sugar, and salt.
Add the vegan butter and use a pastry blender to work it into the flour mixture until it resembles coarse crumbs.
Gradually add the almond milk, stirring with a fork until the dough comes together.
Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured surface and roll it out to a thickness of about 1/8 inch.
Transfer the dough to a 9-inch tart pan with a removable bottom.
In a separate bowl, mix together the sliced apples, vanilla bean paste, and cinnamon.
Arrange the apple mixture in the tart shell, leaving a 1-inch border around the edges.
Fold the edges of the pastry up over the apples, pressing gently to seal.
Brush the pastry with a little almond milk and sprinkle with sugar.
Bake the tart for 40-45 minutes, or until the pastry is golden brown and the apples are tender.
